title: 43% vs. 43%: Why Trump and Biden Are Tied in Our New Poll

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜总会当DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上你都要带300件你最珍贵的私藏去上班，然后把DJ台变成一个像是由精美50年历史艺术品组成的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼推出的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。k

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: Now that Donald Trump has been charged in three different criminal cases,
sentences.zh: 既然唐纳德·特朗普已经在三起不同的刑事案件中被起诉，

sentences.en: the biggest question in American politics is whether it creates an opening for his Republican rivals in the presidential race or disqualifies him in the eyes of general election voters.
sentences.zh: 美国政治中最大的问题是，这会为他在总统竞选中的共和党竞争对手创造机会，还是会让他在大选选民眼中失去资格。

sentences.en: My colleague, Nate Cohn, analyzes a new set of Times polls that answer those questions.
sentences.zh: 我的同事内特·科恩分析了《纽约时报》的一组新民调，这些民调回答了这些问题。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, August 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月3日，星期四。

sentences.en: Hello again.
sentences.zh: 你好，又见面了。

sentences.en: Hi, Nate.
sentences.zh: 嗨，内特。

sentences.en: Is that what I think it just was?
sentences.zh: 刚才那个是我以为的声音吗？

sentences.en: The sounds I was hearing?
sentences.zh: 我听到的声音？

sentences.en: Was that a partner obligingly getting rid of an animal from your apartment so that you could record with The Daily?
sentences.zh: 是不是哪个伴侣为了让你能录制《每日新闻》，很贴心地把一只动物从你公寓里弄走？

sentences.en: That is exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: The things we ask of you all.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们对大家的要求。

sentences.en: Yeah, the dog was chewing on a treat and it occurred to me that there was like a 100% chance that when you all really got down to listening to my audio,
sentences.zh: 对，那只狗在嚼零食，我突然想到，等你们真正静下心来听我的音频时，有百分之百的概率，

sentences.en: you were going to hear the sound in the background or whatever.
sentences.zh: 你们会听到背景里的声音或者别的什么。

sentences.en: I appreciate that.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So, Nate,
sentences.zh: 所以，内特，

sentences.en: we wanted to talk to you because the Times just finished a series of major polls about the state of the 2024 presidential race at a really important juncture when the Republican primary field is now fully formed.
sentences.zh: 我们想跟你聊聊，因为《时报》刚刚完成了一系列关于2024年总统大选选情的重大民调，正值共和党初选格局现在完全成型这一极其重要的关头。

sentences.en: And the frontrunner, Donald Trump, has now been indicted three different times, most recently for his efforts to overturn the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 而领跑者唐纳德·特朗普现在已经被三次起诉，最近的一次是因为他试图推翻2020年大选的努力。

sentences.en: And, of course, we have learned from you to say that polls are not predictive.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们从你那里学到了要说民调不具预测性。

sentences.en: They are snapshots in time.
sentences.zh: 它们只是时间上的快照。

sentences.en: But that said, let's start with the Times poll of Republican voters in the Republican presidential primary, which feels very relevant at this very moment.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，让我们从《时报》对共和党总统初选中共和党选民的民调开始，这在当下感觉非常相关。

sentences.en: So, top line, what did we find?
sentences.zh: 那么，最核心的数据，我们发现了什么？

sentences.en: Top line, we found Donald Trump doing really well.
sentences.zh: 核心数据是，我们发现唐纳德·特朗普表现得非常好。

sentences.en: He had 54% of Republican primary voters to 17% for Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 他在共和党初选选民中获得了54%的支持率，而罗恩·德桑蒂斯为17%。

sentences.en: That's a 37-point lead.
sentences.zh: 这是一个37个百分点的领先优势。

sentences.en: Nate, I think the word you're looking for is crushing, not just very well.
sentences.zh: 内特，我想你用的词应该是压倒性，而不仅仅是很好。

sentences.en: I mean, that is a crushing lead.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个压倒性的领先优势。

sentences.en: It is a crushing lead.
sentences.zh: 这是一个压倒性的领先优势。

sentences.en: It's much larger than the lead that Donald Trump ever had in the last Republican primary.
sentences.zh: 它比唐纳德·特朗普在上一次共和党初选中获得的任何领先优势都要大得多。

sentences.en: It's bigger than any of the leads that Hillary Clinton had in 2016 or 2008.
sentences.zh: 它比希拉里·克林顿在2016年或2008年获得的任何领先优势都要大。

sentences.en: It's the sort of range where Donald Trump is a overwhelming frontrunner, at least if we have a big asterisk over all of his legal challenges.
sentences.zh: 这差不多是唐纳德·特朗普作为压倒性领跑者的范围，至少如果我们对他所有的法律挑战画上一个大大的星号的话。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, that brings me to the inevitable question.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就引出了不可避免的问题。

sentences.en: How do we explain a lead that big after midterms in which candidates backed by Trump did pretty poorly and after several indictments of him in the past few months?
sentences.zh: 在特朗普支持的候选人在中期选举中表现相当糟糕以及过去几个月对他进行多次起诉之后，我们该如何解释如此巨大的领先优势？

sentences.en: This kind of a lead, given all that, does not at all feel like an inevitability.
sentences.zh: 鉴于这一切，这种领先优势一点也不让人觉得是不可避免的。

sentences.en: So, how does the poll account for it?
sentences.zh: 那么，民调是如何解释这一点的呢？

sentences.en: Well, it accounts for it in one of the most straightforward and direct ways that a poll can account for it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它是以民调能够解释的最直接、最直白的方式之一来解释的。

sentences.en: According to our poll, Republicans overwhelmingly reject the notion that Donald Trump committed serious federal crimes.
sentences.zh: 根据我们的民调，共和党人绝大多数拒绝接受唐纳德·特朗普犯下了严重联邦罪行的说法。

sentences.en: And they also believe that Donald Trump is likelier to beat Joe Biden than his rival Ron DeSantis, even though, as you just mentioned in the last election,
sentences.zh: 他们还认为唐纳德·特朗普比他的竞争对手罗恩·德桑蒂斯更有可能击败乔·拜登，尽管正如你刚才在上一次选举中所提到的那样，

sentences.en: Donald Trump's candidates seem to fare quite poorly, while Ron DeSantis did well.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普的候选人似乎表现相当糟糕，而罗恩·德桑蒂斯表现很好。

sentences.en: And never mind the fact, of course, that Donald Trump actually did lose to Joe Biden three years ago.
sentences.zh: 当然，更不用说唐纳德·特朗普三年前确实输给了乔·拜登这一事实了。

sentences.en: Well,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: let's drill down to which Republicans you're referring to when you say that the majority of them think Trump has done nothing wrong and that he's the strongest Republican nominee to take on a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 让我们详细剖析一下，当你指大多数人认为特朗普没有做错任何事，并且他是迎战民主党的最强共和党候选人时，你指的是哪些共和党人。

sentences.en: And the group that I'm most curious about is the Trump MAGA base, this reliable group of supporters who seem to never abandon him no matter what.
sentences.zh: 我最好奇的群体是特朗普的MAGA基本盘，这个可靠的支持者群体似乎无论如何也永远不会抛弃他。

sentences.en: So, what does this poll find about that group of voters in this moment?
sentences.zh: 那么，这次民调对当下这部分选民有什么发现？

sentences.en: Well, the MAGA base doesn't account for all of Trump's support, but it is a lot of it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，MAGA基本盘并没有占到特朗普支持率的全部，但占了很大一部分。

sentences.en: But the poll finds that the base of MAGA voters is about 37 percent of all Republicans.
sentences.zh: 但民调发现，MAGA选民的基本盘大约占所有共和党人的37%。

sentences.en: And these are people who said that they had a very favorable view of Donald Trump and said they strongly supported him in the Republican primary.
sentences.zh: 这些人表示他们对唐纳德·特朗普持有非常有利的看法，并表示他们在共和党初选中强烈支持他。

sentences.en: And look, that's a big group of Republicans.
sentences.zh: 听着，这是一大群共和党人。

sentences.en: It's more than one third of the party.
sentences.zh: 占了党内三分之一以上。

sentences.en: We talk about it a lot, but it's an enormous achievement for Trump.
sentences.zh: 我们经常讨论它，但这对于特朗普来说是一个巨大的成就。

sentences.en: And in our poll, none, that is zero of the respondents in this MAGA category, said that Donald Trump has committed serious federal crimes.
sentences.zh: 在我们的民调中，没有一个，也就是零个处于这个MAGA类别的受访者表示唐纳德·特朗普犯下了严重的联邦罪行。

sentences.en: Zero.
sentences.zh: 零。

sentences.en: Zero.
sentences.zh: 零。

sentences.en: Only 2 percent said that he did, quote, something wrong.
sentences.zh: 只有2%的人表示他做了，用引号说，某些错事。

sentences.en: So, this isn't a case where, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，这不是那种，你知道的，

sentences.en: there are loyal Trump supporters that acknowledge his wrongdoing but still support him anyway because of his views on the issues or because they're loyal to him.
sentences.zh: 有些忠诚的特朗普支持者承认他做错了事，但由于他在议题上的观点或者因为对他忠诚，依然支持他的情况。

sentences.en: They don't accept the premise that he's done something wrong here.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不接受他在这次事件中做错了事的前提。

sentences.en: And that obviously goes a long way to explaining why they continue to support him.
sentences.zh: 这显然在很大程度上解释了为什么他们继续支持他。

sentences.en: Right, because in their mind, there's nothing, literally nothing to see here.
sentences.zh: 对，因为在他们看来，这里没什么好看的，字面意义上没什么好看的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's interesting because I think this gives us a little bit of a basis in data for what we have kind of assumed of the Trump base,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这很有趣，因为我认为这为我们对特朗普基本盘的一些既有假设提供了一些数据基础，

sentences.en: which is that it doesn't view an indictment, any indictment, as any kind of harming factor to Trump.
sentences.zh: 也就是它不认为起诉，任何起诉，是对特朗普的任何形式的伤害因素。

sentences.en: In some ways, it may instead endear him to them.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，它反而可能让他更受他们喜爱。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: It's possible.
sentences.zh: 有可能。

sentences.en: We had one question that I think got at this, which is that we asked voters whether they thought Republicans needed to stand with Trump in the face of these allegations
sentences.zh: 我们有一个问题我认为切中了这一点，那就是我们问选民，他们是否认为面对这些指控，共和党人需要坚定支持特朗普，

sentences.en: or whether it was okay if Republicans didn't stand by Trump.
sentences.zh: 还是说共和党人不坚定支持特朗普也没关系。

sentences.en: Not even that they needed to be against him, just is it okay to not stand by Trump?
sentences.zh: 甚至不是说他们需要反对他，只是说不坚定支持特朗普没关系吗？

sentences.en: And over 90% of these MAGA voters said that Republicans need to stand by Donald Trump in the face of these allegations.
sentences.zh: 超过90%的这些MAGA选民表示，面对这些指控，共和党人需要坚定支持唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Now, I should say we finished this poll before Trump was indicted for his efforts to overturn the election.
sentences.zh: 现在我必须说明，我们在特朗普因试图推翻大选而被起诉之前就完成了这项民调。

sentences.en: But there's not much reason to think this third indictment will change that view among these voters.
sentences.zh: 但没有太多理由认为这第三次起诉会改变这些选民的这种看法。

sentences.en: And to this point, they have seen their guy as under attack and want to rally to his defense.
sentences.zh: 而且到目前为止，他们一直看到自己支持的人受到攻击，并希望团结起来支持他。

sentences.en: Not that they see something wrong on Trump's part and that they should distance themselves from him.
sentences.zh: 而不是看到特朗普有不对的地方，从而应该与他保持距离。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So by my math, given that Trump has 54% of Republican voters supporting him, and given how big the MAGA base is,
sentences.zh: 所以根据我的计算，鉴于特朗普拥有54%的共和党选民支持，并且鉴于MAGA基本盘如此之大，

sentences.en: there's still 17% of Republicans supporting him who aren't what you would define as his MAGA base.
sentences.zh: 仍然有17%的共和党人支持他，而这些人并不是你所定义的MAGA基本盘。

sentences.en: So who are these 17% and why are they with Trump, according to the poll, versus one of his rivals?
sentences.zh: 那么这17%是谁，根据民调，为什么他们支持特朗普而不是他的竞争对手之一？

sentences.en: Well, first, it's just worth saying why we don't think they're part of the MAGA base.
sentences.zh: 首先，值得说明的是为什么我们认为他们不属于MAGA基本盘。

sentences.en: And that's because they either said they don't support Trump strongly when we asked them, or they said they only have a somewhat favorable view of Trump.
sentences.zh: 那是因为当我们询问时，他们要么表示他们对特朗普不是坚定支持，要么表示他们对特朗普只有某种程度的有利看法。

sentences.en: So there's clearly something about him that they don't like too much.
sentences.zh: 所以关于他，显然有一些地方是他们不太喜欢的。

sentences.en: In a lot of ways, they're broadly representative of all Republicans.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，他们大致代表了所有共和党人。

sentences.en: And we didn't really talk very much about the makeup of the MAGA base, but the MAGA base is very populiSt.
sentences.zh: 我们刚才没有过多讨论MAGA基本盘的构成，但MAGA基本盘非常民粹主义。

sentences.en: It's blue-collar.
sentences.zh: 它是蓝领的。

sentences.en: It's very conservative.
sentences.zh: 它是非常保守的。

sentences.en: This group of voters is more affluent.
sentences.zh: 这部分选民更富裕。

sentences.en: It's likelier to say that they're only somewhat conservative, or in some cases even call themselves moderates.
sentences.zh: 他们更有可能说自己只是有点保守，或者在某些情况下甚至称自己为温和派。

sentences.en: They still have views that align with the Republican Party as a whole, but they're not all in one camp.
sentences.zh: 他们的观点仍然与整个共和党保持一致，但他们并非全盘倒向一个阵营。

sentences.en: And by their own account, they're open to candidates other than Donald Trump in the primary campaign.
sentences.zh: 按他们自己的说法，他们在初选活动中对唐纳德·特朗普以外的候选人是开放的。

sentences.en: Now, they're backing Donald Trump over the alternatives.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们在替代人选中支持唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: So they're not an automatic vote against him.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不是自动投反对票的人。

sentences.en: And in fact, they believe that Donald Trump is more electable than Ron DeSantis, and they believe he's a stronger leader than Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们认为唐纳德·特朗普比罗恩·德桑蒂斯更具当选可能，并且他们认为他比罗恩·德桑蒂斯更强大。
zh_words: 唐纳德·特朗普比罗恩·德桑蒂斯

sentences.en: But they do concede that Donald Trump is not as moral as Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实承认唐纳德·特朗普没有罗恩·德桑蒂斯那么有道德。

sentences.en: So there are cracks there that hypothetically could lead them to support someone else if the circumstances permitted it.
sentences.zh: 所以那里存在裂痕，如果情况允许，这在假设上可能会导致他们去支持其他人。

sentences.en: They are, in theory, movable.
sentences.zh: 从理论上讲，他们是可以被争取的。

sentences.en: And to that point, do we know how this 17% feels about this giant, looming question of the president's legal problems, the indictments, the trials,
sentences.zh: 顺着这一点，我们知道这17%的人对这个巨大且迫在眉睫的问题——总统的法律问题、起诉、审判，

sentences.en: the potential that he might be convicted before the election or at any moment, and the degree to which that's just a vast liability for him?
sentences.zh: 他可能在大选前或任何时刻被定罪的潜在可能性，以及这对他而言究竟在多大程度上是个巨大的累赘——有什么看法吗？

sentences.en: So even among this group of voters who, you know, again, they're willing to say that DeSantis may be more moral than Trump,
sentences.zh: 所以，即使在这一群选民中，你知道，他们再次愿意承认德桑蒂斯可能比特朗普更有道德，

sentences.en: but they also reject the idea that Trump has committed serious federal crimes.
sentences.zh: 但他们同时也拒绝接受特朗普犯下严重联邦罪行的想法。

sentences.en: And they also believe that Republicans ought to stand behind Trump in the face of these allegations.
sentences.zh: 而且他们也认为，面对这些指控，共和党人应该坚定站在特朗普身后。

sentences.en: And I should note, by the way, that many of the persuadable voters who don't support Donald Trump, and in fact, prefer Ron DeSantis or another Republican candidate,
sentences.zh: 顺便我应该指出，许多不资助唐纳德·特朗普、事实上更喜欢罗恩·德桑蒂斯或其他共和党候选人的可争取选民，

sentences.en: they also think that most of the voters who are open to Donald Trump don't think that he's done very much wrong here.
sentences.zh: 他们也认为，大多数对唐纳德·特朗普持开放态度的选民并不认为他在这次事件中做错了多少。

sentences.en: And they may, in fact, see him as the victim.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至可能实际上将他视为受害者。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太迷人了。

sentences.en: You know, there's an information ecosystem that is in play here.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这里有一个正在发挥作用的信息生态系统。

sentences.en: Most of these voters are getting their information from a conservative media landscape
sentences.zh: 这些选民大多数是从保守派媒体版图中获取信息的，

sentences.en: where they're hearing that Donald Trump has been mistreated, the allegations are trumped up, that no one else got charged for doing the same thing, and so on.
sentences.zh: 在那里他们听到唐纳德·特朗普受到了虐待，这些指控是捏造的，没有其他人因为做同样的事而被起诉，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think we should be open to the idea that if that media environment ever changed, that maybe voters would become more receptive to a different message.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我认为我们应该对这样一种观点保持开放态度，即如果那种媒体环境发生了改变，也许选民会对不同的信息变得更具接受度。

sentences.en: But at least in that context, the idea that Ron DeSantis can get up there and say
sentences.zh: 但至少在这种背景下，罗恩·德桑蒂斯站出来说

sentences.en: Donald Trump is a criminal is, you know, maybe it would break the ice or something, so to speak, on this argument with the Republican base, but it could just as easily backfire.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普是个罪犯，你知道，也许这可以打破与共和党基本盘在这场争论中的僵局，或者类似的说法，但它也同样容易适得其反。

sentences.en: So if you're Ron DeSantis, the number two in this race, and you and your campaign are looking at this poll, and we know they're looking at this poll,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是罗恩·德桑蒂斯，这场竞选中的第二名，而你和你的竞选团队正在看着这份民调，我们也知道他们在看这份民调，

sentences.zh: 你似乎在说，拜登总统没有找到利用特朗普弱点的方法，因为他作为候选人也有自己真正的弱点。

sentences.en: But let's really explore what those weaknesses are and how they emerge in the poll.
sentences.zh: 但让我们真正探讨一下这些弱点是什么，以及它们是如何在民调中显现出来的。

sentences.en: I would put his weaknesses into three buckets.
sentences.zh: 我会把他的弱点归为三类。

sentences.en: One is something that could be a problem for any president running for re-election,
sentences.zh: 一是任何寻求连任的总统都可能遇到的问题，

sentences.en: which is that voters don't like the state of the economy and they don't think the country is heading in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 那就是选民不喜欢经济现状，他们认为国家没有朝着正确的方向发展。

sentences.en: An overwhelming majority of voters still think America is heading off on the wrong track and voters don't have a good impression of the economy either.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数选民仍然认为美国正在走上错误的道路，而且选民对经济也没有好印象。

sentences.en: Even though there's a case that the economy is getting better, 49 percent of voters in this poll said the economy was poor to just 2 percent who said it was excellent.
sentences.zh: 尽管有观点认为经济正在好转，但本次民调中49%的选民表示经济糟糕，只有2%的选民认为经济极好。

sentences.en: And those perceptions of the economy are much worse than they were in the summer of 2020 at the depth of the COVID recession when businesses were closed and people were staying at home.
sentences.zh: 而且，这种对经济的看法比2020年夏天新冠衰退最严重时期（当时企业关闭、人们居家隔离）还要糟糕得多。

sentences.en: Now, voters may not be right about whether the economy is better or worse than it was then.
sentences.zh: 现在，选民对于经济是比当时更好还是更糟的看法可能并不准确。

sentences.en: I'll leave that to the economists to debate.
sentences.zh: 我把这留给经济学家去争论。

sentences.en: But what's clear is that Biden is certainly not getting credit for the improving economy yet.
sentences.zh: 但显而易见的是，拜登显然还没有因为正在改善的经济而获得赞誉。

sentences.en: And he may still be blamed for an economy that voters simply don't think is good at all.
sentences.zh: 而且他可能仍然会为选民根本认为不好的经济状况背锅。

sentences.en: The second bucket, I think, is Biden's age.
sentences.zh: 我认为第二类是拜登的年龄问题。

sentences.en: In our poll, only half of Democrats think Biden should be re-nominated.
sentences.zh: 在我们的民调中，只有一半的民主党人认为拜登应该再次获得提名。

sentences.en: And half of those Democrats, in an open-ended question,
sentences.zh: 在回答一个开放式问题时，

sentences.en: volunteered that they thought Biden's age or his mental acuity or his health were the reason why they thought someone else should be nominated.
sentences.zh: 这些民主党人中有半数自愿表示，他们认为拜登的年龄、智力敏锐度或健康状况是他们认为应该提名其他人的原因。

sentences.en: These are Democrats who presumably should be giving Biden the benefit of the doubt on all of this stuff.
sentences.zh: 这些民主党人本应在所有这些事情上给拜登保留一些余地。

sentences.en: I just want to zero in on this.
sentences.zh: 我只想把焦点集中在这个问题上。

sentences.en: You're saying half of Democratic voters in this general election poll, voters who, in theory, should be quite faithful to their party's frontrunner,
sentences.zh: 你是说在这场大选民调中，有一半的民主党选民——从理论上讲，这些选民应该对他们党内的领头羊相当忠诚——

sentences.en: they don't think he should be re-nominated.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他不应该再次获得提名。

sentences.en: And when you ask them an open-ended question of why and put it to them, didn't suggest anything to them.
sentences.zh: 而当你问他们原因并提出开放式问题时，并没有向他们暗示任何东西。

sentences.en: Didn't put anything in their mouth on this.
sentences.zh: 在这件事上没有把话塞进他们嘴里。

sentences.en: They volunteer age.
sentences.zh: 他们主动提到了年龄。

sentences.en: I guess we should extrapolate that if Democrats feel that way, so do independents and Republicans.
sentences.zh: 我想我们可以推断，如果民主党人有这种感觉，那么无党派人士和共和党人也是如此。

sentences.en: That's always a good rule of thumb.
sentences.zh: 这历来是一个不错的经验法则。

sentences.en: If one party's base is upset at something about their party, you can only imagine what the independents and the other side think about it.
sentences.zh: 如果一个政党的基本盘对该党的一些事情感到不满，你完全可以想象无党派人士和另一方对此作何感想。

sentences.en: So I think this is almost certainly a problem for Biden in some respect.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这在某种程度上几乎肯定是拜登的一个问题。

sentences.en: And I think the question that I have is, could it be the case that Biden's age is such a severe drag on him that it prevents voters from seeing him as doing an effective job,
sentences.zh: 我认为我有的疑问是，有没有可能拜登的年龄对他来说是一个如此严重的拖累，以至于阻碍了选民看到他正在做有效的工作，

sentences.en: even if he is by many sort of quantitative measures like the number of pieces of legislation he passes or the state of the economy,
sentences.zh: 即使他从许多诸如通过的法案数量或经济状况等定量指标来看确实做得不错，

sentences.en: simply because he seems too feeble to believe he could really be doing the job well.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为他看起来太虚弱了，让人无法相信他真的能把工作做好。

sentences.en: I think that's a possibility.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是可能的。

sentences.en: How much of his problem is in the second bucket, I don't know, but I think it's above zero.
sentences.zh: 他的问题有多少在于第二类，我不知道，但我认为它高于零。

sentences.en: Let's say that.
sentences.zh: 我们这么说吧。

sentences.en: Okay, what's the third Biden weakness?
sentences.zh: 好吧，拜登的第三个弱点是什么？

sentences.en: The third issue is a little bit different from the first two, and that's that Biden is not faring well by traditional Democratic standards among Black and Hispanic voters.
sentences.zh: 第三个问题与前两个有点不同，那就是拜登在黑人和西班牙裔选民中按照传统的民主党标准表现并不好。

sentences.en: Among all registered voters, Biden only has a 71 to 12 lead among Black voters, and he's only up 41 to 38 among Hispanic voters.
sentences.zh: 在所有注册选民中，拜登在黑人选民中仅以71比12领先，在西班牙裔选民中仅以41比38领先。

sentences.en: Now, these are small subsamples.
sentences.zh: 现在，这些是较小的子样本。

sentences.en: They're just, you know, their polls will have margin of errors ordinarily, and then when you drill down onto smaller groups, those margin of errors get even bigger.
sentences.zh: 它们只是，你知道的，它们的民调通常会有误差范围，然后当你细分到更小的群体时，这些误差范围会变得更大。

sentences.en: But we have seen these problems for Democrats and Joe Biden before.
sentences.zh: 但我们以前已经看到民主党人和乔·拜登遇到过这些问题。

sentences.en: In the midterm election, Black turnout was really quite weak, and the Democratic challenge among Hispanic voters has sort of been steadily increasing over time.
sentences.zh: 在期中选举中，黑人投票率确实相当低，而民主党在西班牙裔选民中面临的挑战随着时间的推移一直在稳步增加。

sentences.en: So although these are small samples, they're part of a story that I think we know is already unfolding.
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管这些是小样本，但它们是我们认为已经在上演的故事的一部分。

sentences.en: And that is preventing Biden from maximizing his base of Democratic support and getting his number up above 43.
sentences.zh: 这阻碍了拜登最大化其民主党基本盘支持并将其支持率推高到43%以上。

sentences.en: Right, and I'm thinking if you're a Democrat,
sentences.zh: 没错，我在想如果你是一个民主党人，

sentences.en: there's a little bit of a deja vu feeling here because that long story you're describing is part of what really hurt Hillary Clinton against Donald Trump in 2016,
sentences.zh: 这里会有一种似曾相识的感觉，因为你所描述的那个漫长的故事正是2016年真正伤害希拉里·克林顿对阵唐纳德·特朗普的原因的一部分，

sentences.en: which was that Black voters didn't turn out in large numbers for her.
sentences.zh: 那就是黑人选民没有大量出来为她投票。

sentences.en: Honestly, I think this is a notch worse than that.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我认为这比那还要糟糕一点。

sentences.en: I mean, what we see since 2016 isn't simply a low turnout among Black and Hispanic voters.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们自2016年以来看到的不仅是黑人和西班牙裔选民的投票率低。

sentences.en: We increasingly see both Democratic turnout declining further, and now Republicans beginning to actually make gains.
sentences.zh: 我们越来越多地看到民主党投票率进一步下降，而现在共和党人开始真正取得进展。

sentences.en: So it's not just that non-white voters seem to be staying home.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是非白人选民似乎呆在家里。

sentences.en: It's that some more of the non-white voters who are turning out are supporting Donald Trump and other Republican candidates.
sentences.zh: 而是更多的出来投票的非白人选民正在支持唐纳德·特朗普和其他共和党候选人。

sentences.en: And again, this is just one poll, small sample size, caveat, caveat, caveat.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这只是一项民调，样本量小，有前提，有前提，有前提。

sentences.en: But that is very present here again.
sentences.zh: 但这在这里再次非常明显地存在着。

sentences.en: And that is holding back Biden's overall level of support in the poll.
sentences.zh: 这正在拖累拜登在民调中的整体支持水平。

sentences.en: Okay, so that helps us understand Biden's weakness.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这有助于我们理解拜登的弱点。

sentences.en: And given that at this moment he's tied with Trump at 43% of the electorate that was polled here,
sentences.zh: 鉴于目前他与特朗普在本次民调的选民中以43%对43%打成平手，

sentences.en: that leaves us with about 14% of the general election voters who seem up for grabs.
sentences.zh: 这给我们留下了大约14%的大选选民，他们似乎是摇摆不定的目标。

sentences.en: So what can you tell us about that group of people?
sentences.zh: 那么关于这群人，你能告诉我们些什么？

sentences.en: Well, the main thing that characterizes this group is that they don't like either of these candidates.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这群人最主要的特征是他们对这两个候选人都很不满意。

sentences.en: But to be honest, they're not a bad group for Democrats on paper, and they're not a bad group for Joe Biden on paper.
sentences.zh: 但说实话，从纸面上来看，他们对民主党来说并不是一个坏群体，对乔·拜登来说也不是一个坏群体。

sentences.en: This is a group that's disproportionately young.
sentences.zh: 这是一群年轻人比例过高的人。

sentences.en: It's disproportionately Black and Latino.
sentences.zh: 他们的黑人和拉丁裔比例过高。

sentences.en: It's disproportionately Democratic.
sentences.zh: 他们的民主党支持者比例过高。

sentences.en: And maybe most importantly, it disproportionately supported Joe Biden in the last presidential election.
sentences.zh: 也许最重要的是，他们在上届总统大选中对乔·拜登的支持比例过高。

sentences.en: Now, the fact that they supported Biden last time doesn't mean they'll support him again.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们上次支持拜登并不意味着他们这次还会支持他。

sentences.en: But it suggests that the Democrats and Joe Biden specifically ought to have an easier time than Donald Trump making gains among this other 14% of the electorate.
sentences.zh: 但这表明，民主党人、特别是乔·拜登，在争取这另外14%选民的支持时，应该会比唐纳德·特朗普更容易取得进展。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So this could ultimately be a decisive group of voters in a general election matchup between Trump and Biden.
sentences.zh: 所以在特朗普和拜登的大选对决中，这最终可能成为决定胜负的一群选民。

sentences.en: It most certainly could be.
sentences.zh: 这绝对有可能。

sentences.en: But they're not undecided in the sense that they don't know who these people are and don't have to make up their minds.
sentences.zh: 但他们并不是那种不知道这些候选人是谁、也不需要下定决心的那种“未决定”选民。

sentences.en: Again,
sentences.zh: 话说回来，

sentences.en: these are people who are sort of recoiling at the thought of having to choose between these two and maybe not even getting to the point where they can tell us the decision that not only they made last time,
sentences.zh: 这些人一想到不得不在两害相权中抉择，就会本能地退缩，甚至可能还没想好他们上次投了谁，

sentences.en: but that they'll make again.
sentences.zh: 以及这次会投给谁。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's also risk, of course, that they really don't vote or vote for someone else in a third party candidate as an expression of that dissatisfaction.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，当然也存在这种风险：为了表达这种不满，他们真的就不去投票了，或者把票投给第三方候选人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So a general election featuring these two candidates could very much be about not just who earns the affections of this 14% of voters who would break a tie,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果有一场由这两位候选人对决的大选，其关键可能不仅在于谁能赢得这14%能打破僵局的选民的青睐，

sentences.en: but who this 14% dislikes the leaSt.
sentences.zh: 还在于这14%的人最讨厌谁。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And right now, if the election is about who they dislike the least, it's really good for Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 而现在，如果选举取决于谁最不招人讨厌，这对乔·拜登来说真的非常有利。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a group that's very hostile towards Donald Trump, even if it doesn't love Joe Biden by any stretch.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这群人对唐纳德·特朗普抱有极大的敌意，尽管他们绝谈不上多么喜爱乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Mm hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Now, I do want to caution a little bit on how much upside there is for Joe Biden here.
sentences.zh: 现在，对于乔·拜登在这里还有多大的上升空间，我确实想稍微保留一点谨慎。

sentences.en: If we take these voters and we assume that they'll vote in 2024 the same way that they voted in 2020, Joe Biden's lead only grows to two points.
sentences.zh: 如果我们假设这些选民在2024年的投票倾向和2020年完全一样，乔·拜登的领先优势也只会扩大到两个百分点。

sentences.en: So it's not like there's some landslide around the corner once these 14% of voters make up their minds.
sentences.zh: 所以，并不是说这14%的选民一旦拿定主意，就会出现什么压倒性的胜利。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That makes me want to touch on something you just mentioned, which is the possibility of a third party candidate.
sentences.zh: 这让我想谈谈你刚才提到的一点，那就是出现第三方候选人的可能性。

sentences.en: When you take math like a 2% lead or a tie, a decision by a third party to enter this race, whether it's the Green Party or no labels,
sentences.zh: 当你面对2%的领先优势或平局这样的微弱差距时，第三方决定加入这场竞选——无论是绿党还是“不贴标签”组织，

sentences.en: which is thinking of putting up a candidate in this general election, that could prove extremely important with math this tight.
sentences.zh: 该组织正考虑在这场大选中推出一位候选人——在选情如此胶着的情况下，这可能会变得极其重要。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It's not hard to imagine how a minor party candidate or a series of minor party candidates could attract considerable support.
sentences.zh: 不难想象，一个小党候选人或一系列小党候选人如何能吸引到相当可观的支持。

sentences.en: You know, back in 2016, the minor party candidates got something like 6% of the vote.
sentences.zh: 你知道，早在2016年，小党候选人就获得了大约6%的选票。

sentences.en: Mm hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: The voters are not as negative on Biden or Trump as they were on Clinton and Trump back in 2016.
sentences.zh: 选民对拜登或特朗普的反感，不像2016年对克林顿和特朗普那么强烈。

sentences.en: But there are shades of 2016 here where the voters at the near the center of the electorate really don't like either of these people, which was not true in 2020,
sentences.zh: 但这里有2016年的影子，接近选民中心的这部分人真的很讨厌这两个人，这在2020年是不存在的，

sentences.en: where most voters did have a favorable view of Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 当时大多数选民对乔·拜登确实抱有好感。

sentences.en: So, Nate, how are you thinking about the rest of this campaign, given the snapshot of the race that we have just taken with these polls this many months before people start voting?
sentences.zh: 那么，内特，鉴于我们在人们开始投票数月前通过这些民调刚刚对这场竞选进行了快照式的了解，你是如何看待这场竞选接下来的走势的？

sentences.en: To me, the biggest takeaway is that it means that all of the events of the last few years, the Stop the Steal movement, the Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe versus Wade,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，最大的收获意味着过去几年发生的所有事件——“制止偷窃”运动、最高法院推翻罗诉韦德案裁决的决定、

sentences.en: all these criminal indictments have not disqualified Donald Trump, at least not when he's facing a Joe Biden with a 39% approval rating.
sentences.zh: 所有这些刑事起诉——都还没有让唐纳德·特朗普失去竞选资格，至少在面对支持率仅为39%的乔·拜登时是这样的。

sentences.en: And this race is competitive.
sentences.zh: 而且这场竞选竞争非常激烈。

sentences.en: And at least right now, the Democrats have work cut out ahead of them.
sentences.zh: 至少现在看来，民主党人还有很多硬仗要打。

sentences.en: And the events of the last three years haven't brought this race to an early end, as some might have thought.
sentences.zh: 过去三年的事件并没有像某些人想象的那样，让这场竞选提前结束。

sentences.en: And if you're Joe Biden and you see this poll, and like DeSantis and his staff, you've seen this poll, what do you do in response to it?
sentences.zh: 如果你是乔·拜登，看到这个民调，就像德桑蒂斯及其幕僚一样看到了这个民调，你会有什么反应？

sentences.en: I think that if you're the Biden campaign, that your task is fairly straightforward, not necessarily to pull off, but at least to identify.
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果你是拜登的竞选团队，你的任务其实相当明确，倒不是说一定容易做到，但至少方向是清晰的。

sentences.en: You've got to convince voters the economy is good and hope that the news continues to be good enough to potentially boost those numbers further.
sentences.zh: 你必须说服选民经济形势很好，并希望好消息能继续保持下去，从而有可能进一步提振这些支持率。

sentences.en: You have to persuade voters that you're doing a decent job and they'll probably never persuade people that you're not too old to be president,
sentences.zh: 你必须说服选民你干得还算不错，虽然你可能永远无法说服人们你没有老到不适合当总统，

sentences.en: but at least persuade them that you're good enough to, you know, lead the country.
sentences.zh: 但至少要说服他们，你足够胜任领导这个国家的工作。

sentences.en: And then third, you have to remind voters of the reasons they didn't support Donald Trump last time and why they continue not to like him in our poll,
sentences.zh: 第三，你必须提醒选民他们上次不支持唐纳德·拜登（应为特朗普）的原因，以及为什么在我们的民调中他们依然不喜欢他，

sentences.en: that a majority of voters don't have a favorable view of the guy, think that he's a threat to democracy, and think that he's committed serious crimes.
sentences.zh: 即大多数选民对这个人没有好感，认为他是对民主的威胁，并认为他犯下了严重的罪行。

sentences.en: Whether Biden can execute on that easily is not the same as saying that the path is open, of course, but I think that path is straightforward.
sentences.zh: 当然，拜登能否轻易兑现这一点，并不等于说通往胜利的道路已经完全敞开，但我认为这条路径是清晰的。

sentences.en: On the Trump side of the ledger,
sentences.zh: 至于特朗普这一边，

sentences.en: I think that is a little weirder to think about what Trump needs to do in the same sort of term because the poll doesn't really suggest that he has an obvious path to like 51% of the vote or something.
sentences.zh: 我认为从同样的逻辑来思考特朗普需要做什么会显得有点诡异，因为民调并未真正显示他有一条通往51%左右选票之类结果的明显路径。

sentences.en: And I find it hard to believe that the people who believe he's a criminal or who believe that he's a threat to democracy can be talked out of that too easily with, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且我很难相信，那些认为他是个罪犯或认为他是民主党（应为民主）威胁的人，能通过竞选活动中的恰当言辞，

sentences.en: the right words on the trail.
sentences.zh: 就轻而易举地改变看法。

sentences.en: But what you can do is continue to keep your path open by continuing to reinforce Biden's weaknesses.
sentences.zh: 但你能做的是，通过不断强化拜登的弱点，来继续为自己保留一条通往胜利的道路。

sentences.en: You can say that Hunter Biden and Joe Biden are also involved in criminal conspiracies.
sentences.zh: 你可以说亨特·拜登和乔·拜登也卷入了犯罪阴谋。

sentences.en: You can continue to appear as a vigorous and energetic candidate that maybe offers a strong contrast to Joe Biden's age.
sentences.zh: 你可以继续以一个充满活力和干劲的候选人形象出现，这或许能与乔·拜登的年龄形成强烈的对比。

sentences.en: You can argue that the economy isn't good and that prices are higher and so on.
sentences.zh: 你可以争辩说经济并不好、物价更高等等。

sentences.en: And that may not be a path to a majority.
sentences.zh: 这可能不是一条通往多数支持的道路。

sentences.en: Donald Trump has never won a majority.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普从未赢得过多数支持。

sentences.en: But does it keep a path open to another narrow victory in these battleground states?
sentences.zh: 但这能否在这些摇摆州为再次险胜保留一条通路呢？

sentences.en: Maybe it does.
sentences.zh: 也许可以。

sentences.en: Well, Nate, as always, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好吧，内特，一如既往，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.

sentences.en: history.

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线条件？
